# Weekly roll-up ruling (e2e agentic synthetic)

Tanya (team owner) ruled on how the week's reactions reach people:

> the per-run bundle stays, and on Fridays we add one roll-up of the week —
> what moved, what is still open — instead of asking anyone to scroll back

Tina asked whether the roll-up replaces the per-run bundle. Tanya held that it
does not: the bundle is for the run, the roll-up is for the week. Rejected: a
daily digest, because most days carry a single run and it would repeat the
bundle word for word.

positions.name: WeeklyRollupVsPerRunBundle
positions.frame: What does each delivery artifact for reactions carry (the per-run bundle, a weekly roll-up, a daily digest), and does one replace another so that people no longer need to scroll back?
positions.why: The four segments read in one direction: how a week's reactions should reach people. src-2 sets the per-run bundle alongside a Friday roll-up. src-3 asks whether the roll-up replaces the bundle. src-4 answers that it does not, because the bundle serves the run and the roll-up serves the week. src-5 rejects a daily digest as redundant on single-run days. The set holds a tension: src-3 questions the coexistence that src-4 settles by ruling, and the frame keeps both sides open rather than resolving them here.

placements.why: The segments settle how a week's reactions reach people: a per-run bundle stays, a Friday roll-up of the week is added so no one has to scroll back, the question of whether the roll-up replaces the bundle is answered no, and a daily digest is rejected as redundant. This is a recurring subject about how decision outcomes are surfaced over time, which future envelopes can keep feeding. It extends the decisions-evaporate problem by addressing delivery cadence, so it sits under that leaf rather than reusing it, since the content is about artifact cadence and not the problem statement itself. No existing leaf names reaction delivery cadence.
placements.title: From scroll-back to a scheduled recap
placements.frame: What must each delivery of a team's reactions carry for people who were not in the run, and does a periodic recap replace the run's own bundle or sit beside it?
